blocks.text: Transition metal complexes ki khaas shakalein hoti hain, jo dhaat ki electronic configuration, coordination number aur ligands ki noiyat par munhasir hain.

items: Linear: dhaat ke ion ke aamne saamne do ligands, 180 darje par, maslan [Ag(NH3)2]Cl aur K[Ag(CN)2].

Square planar: dhaat ka ion aur chaar ligands aik plane mein, square ke konon par, 90 darje ke zaviyon se. Yeh Ni2+ aur Pt2+ jaise d8 ions ki pehchan hai, NH3 aur CN- jaise ligands ke saath, maslan [Ni(CN)4]2- aur [Pt(NH3)4]2+.
Tetrahedral: chaar ligands tetrahedron ke konon par, 109.5 darje ke zaviyon se, maslan [CoCl4]2- aur [MnCl4]2-.

Octahedral: chhe ligands x, y aur z axes ke saath; chaar 90 darje par square plane banate aur do us ke oopar aur neeche, aapas mein 180 darje par. Yeh sab se aam shakal hai, maslan [Cr(NH3)6]3+ aur [Co(en)3]3+.

blocks.alt: Chaar ball-and-stick khaake, surkh dhaat ion aur neele donor atoms: linear, 2 ligands, bond angle 180 darje, [Ag(NH3)2]+; square planar, 4 ligands, 90 darje, [Ni(CN)4]2-; tetrahedral, 4 ligands, 109.5 darje, [CoCl4]2-; octahedral, 6 ligands, 90 darje, [Cr(NH3)6]3+.
blocks.caption: Transition metal complexes ki shakalein (Figure 18.3 ke mutabiq asal khaake).
blocks.long_description: Transition metal complexes ki chaar aam shakalein coordination number aur dhaat ke ion par munhasir hain. Do ligands linear complex (180 darje) dete hain. Chaar ligands ya to square planar complex dete hain, jis mein paanchon atoms aik plane mein aur zaviye 90 darje, ya tetrahedral jis ke zaviye 109.5 darje. Chhe ligands octahedral complex dete hain, sab se aam shakal, jis mein parosi ligands ke darmiyan 90 darje.

blocks.prompt: Lewis acid-base ka tasawwur complex banne ko kaise samjhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Dhaat ka ion Lewis acid hai jo khaali d orbitals mein electron jore leta hai; har ligand Lewis base hai jo lone pair deta hai, is liye har dhaat-ligand bond coordinate bond hai.

blocks.prompt: Cr3+ aur chhe neutral H2O ligands se banne wale complex ka kul charge maloom karein.
[MnCl4]2- ki shakal batayein, jab dhaat ka ion d5 aur coordination number 4 ho.
blocks.explanation: Tetrahedral (bond angle 109.5 darje); square planar d8 ions ki pehchan hai.

blocks.prompt: EDTA hexadentate ligand hai. Hexadentate ka kya matlab hai?
blocks.explanation: Aik EDTA ion chhe donor atoms (do N aur chaar O) ke zariye aik hi dhaat ke ion se chhe coordinate bonds banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Transition metal ion ki woh do khasiyatein batayein jo use complex ions banane deti hain.
blocks.explanation: Is ke paas khaali d orbitals hain, aur yeh orbitals ligands ke lone pairs lene ke liye tawanai mein kaafi neeche (qabil-e-rasai) hain.

items: 2: linear (180); 4: square planar (90) ya tetrahedral (109.5); 6: octahedral (90).
Square planar d8 ions jaise Ni2+ aur Pt2+ ki pehchan.
